title: BS 7671 Section 701: locations containing a bath or shower
edition: BS 7671:2018+A2:2022 Section 701 (IEC 60364-7-701), from the SELECT pocket guide (secondary)
notes: The standard is paywalled; values are from a public summary. The 17th edition asked for sockets 3 m from zone 1; the 18th asks 2.5 m. Shaver supply units (BS EN 61558-2-5) and SELV equipment are allowed in zone 2 and are not yet told apart.

electrical.description: Zone 0 inside the bath or tray (0.10 m high for a shower without a tray), zone 1 above it to 2.25 m (or within 1.2 m of a trayless shower's head), zone 2 a further 0.6 m out; sockets at least 2.5 m from zone 1; IPX7 in zone 0 and IPX4 in zones 1 and 2
